title: Sale Badges
description:
Product labels grab attention, and the right sale badge can be the difference between a browser and a buyer. Jetexir lets you place striking, customizable sale badges on top of your product images so promotions are impossible to miss.

Show the discount as a bold percentage ("-20%") or as a fixed amount ("Save $12"), choose the badge shape, colors, and wording, and position it exactly where you want on both shop archives and single product pages. Sale badges apply automatically to any product on sale, so your storefront always looks polished without manual work.
summary: Customize how sale badges look on your products to attract attention and drive urgency.
features: Display the discount as a percentage sale badge (e.g. "-20%")
Present discounts as fixed amounts ("Save $12") too
Style badge text, colors, and shape to match your brand
Position the badge anywhere on the product image

title: Price Variations
description:
By default, WooCommerce shows variable products as a confusing range, "$49 – $99", which leaves customers guessing what they'll actually pay. Price Variations puts you in control of exactly how those prices are presented on both shop and product pages.

Display the full range in either direction, show just the lowest or just the highest price, or clarify the range with a "From:" or "Up To:" prefix. Every format keeps your pricing transparent, builds trust, and removes the guesswork from the buying decision.
summary: Show variable product prices the way you want, ranges, single prices, or with clear "From" prefixes.
features: Choose from multiple variation price display formats
Show only the lowest or only the highest price
Show price as a range, minimum to maximum or maximum to minimum
Add a "From:" prefix before the minimum price
Add an "Up To:" prefix before the maximum price
Remove the "clear" link from the price display

title: Product Comparison
description:
Help customers make confident buying decisions with a simple, effective product comparison tool. Shoppers add products to a comparison table with one click and review features, prices, and specifications side by side on a dedicated page.

You decide how it works: which attributes get compared, what the buttons say, and how the buttons and compare page look. Comparing options side by side reduces hesitation and gets customers to a purchase faster.
summary: Let shoppers compare products side by side and choose the option that fits them best.
features: Add to compare button on product pages
Dedicated compare page to review products side by side
Choose which attributes appear in the comparison
Set custom text on the compare buttons
Customize the buttons and compare page to match your brand

title: Wishlist
description:
Give shoppers a reason to return with a powerful wishlist feature. Customers can save products they like, review everything on a dedicated wishlist page, and move items straight into the cart whenever they're ready.

You control where the wishlist button appears, before or after the "Add to cart" button, or above the product thumbnail, and which icon it uses. Once an order is placed, purchased products are removed from the wishlist automatically, so saved lists stay clean and relevant.
summary: Let customers save products they love and come back to buy them later.
features: Wishlist button on shop and product pages
Position it before or after "Add to cart", or above the thumbnail
Dedicated page showing all saved products
Choose the button icon from available options
Auto-remove purchased products from the wishlist after checkout
Convert saved products to cart in one click

title: Social Sharing
description:
Word of mouth is one of the most powerful sales tools. Social Sharing adds actionable social icons to your single product pages so customers can share your products across their networks with a single click.

Choose which platforms appear, control the icon content and styling to fit your design, and even offer a one-click "copy link" option. Every share brings free, authentic exposure, reinforcing your brand while driving new visitors back to your store.
summary: Let customers promote your products across social networks in a single click.
features: One-click sharing for every product
Buttons for Facebook, X, WhatsApp, and more
Select which social icons appear
Control the content and appearance of the icons
Copy the product link to the clipboard in one click

title: FAQ Section
description:
Frequently asked questions belong where customers are deciding. The FAQ addon lets you create and display a clean, collapsible FAQ section on any product page, so shoppers find answers in seconds instead of contacting support.

Add unlimited questions per product, or apply a common set of FAQs across all products at once. Answering objections up front builds trust, reduces pre-sale questions, and keeps buyers moving toward checkout, all without slowing down your site.
summary: Answer common questions right on the product page and remove purchase hesitation.
features: Create and manage FAQs for each product
Add the same FAQs to all products at once
Collapsible accordion for clean navigation
No coding required
Lightweight and compatible with most themes

title: Related Products
description:
Displaying the right products at the right moment increases basket size. Related Products gives you full control over which products appear on your single product pages, by category, tag, attribute, or as a hand-picked selection for each product.

Replace WooCommerce's default related products with your own choices, present them as a polished slider or a grid, and guide customers toward complementary items that keep them browsing and buying.
summary: Keep shoppers exploring your catalog with smart, attractive related product blocks.
features: Disable WooCommerce's default related products
Show related products by category, tag, or attribute
Hand-pick specific products to display instead
Display related products as a slider
Control how many products appear and the layout

title: Call for Price
description:
Not every store shows prices publicly. Call for Price lets you replace the price and add-to-cart button with a custom "Call for price" prompt that links to your contact, booking, or quoting channel.

You can also set distinct messaging for products with empty, zero, or out-of-stock prices, and the sale tag is automatically hidden whenever no price is displayed. Whether you run a B2B catalogue, sell by negotiation, or offer quote-based services, your store stays professional and your leads come directly to you.
summary: Hide prices and prompt customers to contact you for the best offer.
features: Display a "Call for price" button on the product page
Custom text for products with empty, zero, or out-of-stock prices
Automatically hide the sale tag on products with empty prices
Perfect for quote-based and B2B catalogues

title: Quantity Fields
description:
The opposite of one-size-fits-all, Quantity Fields adapts the quantity input to your real business rules. Add clear plus and minus buttons, enforce minimum orders, cap maximum quantities, and control the step customers can increment by.

Style the field and buttons to match your theme, disable the quantity controls entirely on the product page, or enforce "Sold individually" across all products in a single setting. Whether you sell per meter, per pack, or per case, everything stays consistent with your fulfillment process.
summary: Customize product quantity inputs to match the way your inventory actually works.
features: Plus and minus buttons on the quantity field
Control the minimum, maximum, and step values
Custom styling for the field and its buttons
Disable the quantity field and buttons on the product page
Set "Sold individually" for all products at once

title: Fly Cart
description:
Reduce abandonment with a shopping experience that never interrupts the customer. Fly Cart slides in instantly whenever a product is added to the cart, with both AJAX and standard Add to Cart buttons, showing the full summary and a direct path to checkout.

Match it to your store by choosing the cart icon and position, and decide exactly where it appears: home, blog, posts, cart, checkout, or product pages. Shoppers keep browsing without friction and return to their cart whenever they're ready.
summary: A fast, elegant slide-in cart that keeps customers shopping without leaving the page.
features: Works with both AJAX and standard Add to Cart buttons
Slide-out cart with an instant summary
Choose your own fly cart icon and position
Show or hide the fly cart per page (home, blog, posts, cart, checkout, product)
Go to checkout in one click

title: Menu Cart
description:
Keep the shopping cart always within reach. Menu Cart adds a beautiful cart indicator to your navigation that shows the live item count at a glance, so customers never have to hunt for their basket.

A dropdown preview gives a quick peek at the current contents, and one click takes shoppers straight to checkout. You control what the dropdown shows and how it's styled, and it works with any menu position in your theme.
summary: A polished cart icon in your menu that always shows the current basket total.
features: Cart icon with a live product count in the menu
Dropdown preview of the current cart
Control the cart content and style
Works with any menu position

title: Checkout Fields
description:
Checkout should feel effortless. Checkout Fields gives you complete control over the checkout form. Add the fields your business needs, edit or rename existing ones, remove the ones you never use, and reorder everything for a natural flow.

Add custom fields conditionally so shoppers only see what's relevant, and validate inputs to keep orders clean and accurate. A simpler checkout means fewer abandoned carts and better order data from the very start.
summary: Shape your checkout to collect exactly the information your business needs.
features: Add, edit, or remove checkout fields
Reorder fields for a logical, effortless flow
Add custom fields conditionally
Validate fields for cleaner, more accurate orders

title: Custom Order Statuses
description:
WooCommerce's built-in statuses don't fit every workflow. Custom Order Statuses lets you define exactly the steps your orders go through, from "Pending Review" to "Shipped via Courier", and rename existing statuses so they match how you actually work.

Control the behavior of your workflow too: choose the default order status, the fallback status used when an order is deleted, and the default status for orders paid via the "Check payments" method. Color-code each status with a custom admin background so your team can read the order queue at a glance.
summary: Model your order workflow with statuses that match your real business process.
features: Create unlimited custom order statuses
Set the default order status and the fallback "delete order" status
Set the default status for the "Check payments" method
Color-code statuses with a custom admin background color
Rename statuses to match your workflow

title: Announcement Bar
description:
Turn your store's top into a marketing channel. The Announcement Bar displays fully customizable messages, flash sales, free shipping thresholds, or brand updates, right where customers can't miss them.

Create as many bars as you need, each with its own content and style, and control exactly where each one appears with display conditions based on pages, categories, or products. Simple to configure, easy to keep on brand, and always in front of the right shoppers.
summary: Broadcast promotions and important notices with stylish, targeted announcement bars.
features: Create multiple announcement bars with different content and styles
Show bars on your desired pages only
Set display conditions per bar (specific pages, categories, or products)
Great for flash sales, shipping info, and news

title: Currency Symbols
description:
Every market formats money differently. Currency Symbols lets you replace WooCommerce's default currency symbol with your own, including a custom icon, and control how prices are formatted across the store.

Set your preferred decimals and thousands separators so every price reads naturally for your local audience, and keep the entire storefront consistent with the currency presentation your customers expect.
summary: Display prices with your own currency symbol, icon, and formatting.
features: Change the currency symbol for your whole store
Set a custom icon for the currency symbol
Custom price formatting
Localized decimals and thousands separators

title: Sale Progress Bar
description:
Turn a sale into a compelling story. The Sale Progress Bar displays a live progress indicator on products that are on sale, showing exactly how many units have been sold and how many are still available.

Shoppers act when they sense scarcity. Seeing "32 of 50 sold" next to a discounted product creates genuine urgency, encouraging customers to buy now instead of coming back later and finding it gone. The bar appears automatically on products on sale, and works perfectly for flash sales, seasonal discounts, and limited-stock launches.
summary: Show how much of a sale has sold and how much stock is left to create real urgency.
features: Display a sales progress bar on the product page
Show the number of products sold and stock remaining
Auto-applies to products currently on sale
Great for flash sales and limited-stock campaigns

title: Order Numbers
description:
Stop explaining your order numbers to customers. Order Numbers replaces WooCommerce's default random order IDs with clean, sequential numbers, 1001, 1002, 1003, in exactly the format your business needs.

Add a prefix like "JX-", include the date, or keep it plain: pick a template (number only, prefix & number, date & number, and more), set your own starting number, and control the increment. Existing orders are reformatted too, so every order across your store follows the same consistent, professional sequence. With order tracking enabled, you can pull up any order's details in seconds.
summary: Organize your orders with clean, sequential numbers in a format that makes sense for your store.
features: Sequential order numbers for every new order
Custom starting number and increment
Add a prefix, date, or both to the order number
Choose from multiple order number templates
Enable order tracking to find order details fast
